subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which path should own the remaining Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread-context fix now that the message-tool half has shipped?
rationale: The remaining bug is source-reproducible, but the direct candidate branches are stale, conflicting, closed, or broader than this issue, so automation should not pick an owner boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Replace With Focused Fix
options.body: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix that persists routable non-direct Mattermost thread context on the correct session entry and includes live cron/heartbeat proof.

options.title: Adopt A Candidate
options.body: Choose one linked candidate branch, rebase it, remove known route/session risks, and make it the canonical fix path.

options.title: Close Remaining Scope
options.body: Close this issue and associated candidates only if maintainers decide Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread recovery is not supported.

recommendation.title: Replace With Focused Fix
recommendation.body: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix that persists routable non-direct Mattermost thread context on the correct session entry and includes live cron/heartbeat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the shipped message-tool fix and have recent adjacent history in the outbound route-threading code that the remaining fix must preserve.
